clean_source_blocks.text: Gabbriette Bechtel and Matty Healy married in a private ceremony on Saturday The 1975's frontman Matty Healy and model Gabriette Bechtel have tied the knot in Los Angeles. The couple announced their engagement in 2024, after dating for nine months, and got married on Saturday. A statement shared from the couple's representatives said the pair were married "at a private ceremony in Los Angeles, attended by their family and close friends". According to several US media outlets, they were married at Madonna's former estate in the Hollywood Hills and celebrities including Charli XCX were in attendance. Bechtel, 28 and Healy, 37 were first linked months after he split from Taylor Swift, whom he dated briefly in 2023. Their relationship allegedly inspired some of the tracks on Swift's acclaimed album, The Tortured Poets Department.

The 1975's frontman Matty Healy and model Gabriette Bechtel have tied the knot in Los Angeles. The couple announced their engagement in 2024, after dating for nine months, and got married on Saturday. A statement shared from the couple's representatives said the pair were married "at a private ceremony in Los Angeles, attended by their family and close friends". According to several US media outlets, they were married at Madonna's former estate in the Hollywood Hills and celebrities including Charli XCX were in attendance. Bechtel, 28 and Healy, 37 were first linked months after he split from Taylor Swift, whom he dated briefly in 2023. Their relationship allegedly inspired some of the tracks on Swift's acclaimed album, The Tortured Poets Department.
The newlyweds were first linked in 2023 after Healy's brief relationship with Taylor Swift.

Before the wedding, Healy celebrated with a bachelor party in Malibu. Videos shared on social media showed him performing with 9075, a tribute band dedicated to The 1975. Bechtel also celebrated with a bachelorette trip to Las Vegas last month. The couple began dating in September 2023. Healy's mother, actress Denise Welch, confirmed their engagement in June 2024. Before his relationship with Bechtel, Healy briefly dated Taylor Swift in 2023 after her split from Joe Alwyn. The two were linked for only a few weeks before going their separate ways. They had also sparked dating rumours in 2014, although Healy later described those rumours as "all fake" and a "farce." Swift has since married Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World | URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5ywxp2d826o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss]
Gabbriette Bechtel and Matty Healy married in a private ceremony on Saturday

The 1975's frontman Matty Healy and model Gabriette Bechtel have tied the knot in Los Angeles.

The couple announced their engagement in 2024, after dating for nine months, and  got married on Saturday.

A statement shared from the couple's representatives said the pair were married "at a private ceremony in Los Angeles, attended by their family and close friends".

According to several US media outlets, they were married at Madonna's former estate in the Hollywood Hills and celebrities including Charli XCX were in attendance.

Bechtel, 28 and Healy, 37 were first linked months after he split from Taylor Swift, whom he dated briefly in 2023. Their relationship allegedly inspired some of the tracks on Swift's acclaimed album, The Tortured Poets Department.

In June 2024, Bechtel shared a photo of her wearing a large black diamond ring on her ring finger on Instagram.

She wrote: "Marrying The 1975 is very brat."

Healy's mother, Loose Women star Denise Welch, later confirmed the engagement on a podcast.

Videos of Healy performing with The 9075 - a tribute band to The 1975 - reportedly at his stag do, circulated online after the event.

Bechtel also shared photos from her Las Vegas hen-do, showing the model being handcuffed and carried onto a plane by a man dressed as a police officer.

Other snaps showed fake 100 dollar bills spread across the floor, her posing with burlesque star Dita Von Teese, and dancing with an Elvis impersonator.

The American model is also a musician, known for being the lead vocalist and songwriter of the punk rock band Nasty Cherry, which was formed by Charli XCX. Her husband, George Daniel, is The 1975's drummer.

The 1975 are known for their songs Chocolate, Somebody Else, and Girls and have had five UK number one albums including their 2013 self-titled debut, 2020's Notes On A Conditional Form and their most recent album, Being Funny In A Foreign Language, which was released in 2022.

They also headlined Glastonbury last year. The band have since gone on an "indefinite hiatus" from performing live shows.

The BBC has contacted Healy and Bechtel for comment.

[Lähde: The News International | URL: https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/1409567-taylor-swifts-ex-matty-healy-marries-model-gabbriette-bechtel-weeks-after-popstars-wedding]
The 1975 frontman Matty Healy weds girlfriend Gabbriette Bechtel at Madonna's former LA estate

Matty Healy and Gabbriette Bechtel are officially married.

The 1975 frontman, 37, and the model, 28, tied the knot on Saturday at Castillo del Lago, Madonna's former estate in Los Angeles, per Just Jared.

Healy wore a black tuxedo, while Bechtel walked down the aisle in a white wedding gown at the Spanish Colonial-style mansion in the Hollywood Hills.

Several celebrities attended the wedding, including Charli xcx and her husband George Daniel, who is Healy's bandmate in The 1975. Other guests included Anastasia Karanikolaou, Fai Khadra, Alex Consani, Devon Lee Carlson, Duke Nicholson, Sydney Lynn Carlson, Tyrell Hampton, Alex O'Connor and Quenlin Blackwell.

Before the wedding, Healy celebrated with a bachelor party in Malibu. Videos shared on social media showed him performing with 9075, a tribute band dedicated to The 1975.

Bechtel also celebrated with a bachelorette trip to Las Vegas last month.

The couple began dating in September 2023. Healy's mother, actress Denise Welch, confirmed their engagement in June 2024.

Before his relationship with Bechtel, Healy briefly dated Taylor Swift in 2023 after her split from Joe Alwyn.

The two were linked for only a few weeks before going their separate ways. They had also sparked dating rumours in 2014, although Healy later described those rumours as "all fake" and a "farce."

Swift has since married Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce.

payload.title: Matty Healy ja Gabbriette Bechtel avioituivat Los Angelesissa
payload.summary: The 1975 -yhtyeen laulaja Matty Healy ja malli Gabbriette Bechtel viettivät yksityisiä häitä perheen ja läheisten ystävien seurassa.
payload.content:
The 1975 -yhtyeen laulaja Matty Healy, 37, ja malli Gabbriette Bechtel, 28, ovat menneet naimisiin Los Angelesissa. Parin edustajien mukaan häitä vietettiin lauantaina yksityisessä tilaisuudessa, johon osallistuivat perheenjäsenet ja parin läheiset ystävät.

## Yksityinen seremonia Los Angelesissa

Pari ilmoitti kihlauksestaan vuonna 2024, kun seurustelua oli takana yhdeksän kuukautta. Healyn äiti, näyttelijä Denise Welch, vahvisti kihlauksen saman vuoden kesäkuussa. Healy ja Bechtel olivat alkaneet seurustella syyskuussa 2023.

Useat yhdysvaltalaismediat ovat kertoneet, että vihkiminen järjestettiin poptähti Madonnan entisellä tilalla Hollywood Hillsissä. Näiden tietojen mukaan vieraiden joukossa oli myös Charli XCX. Parin edustajien lausunnossa tarkkaa hääpaikkaa tai vieraslistaa ei kuitenkaan vahvistettu.

Edustajien lausunto vahvisti vain sen, että seremonia pidettiin Los Angelesissa perheen ja läheisten ystävien läsnä ollessa. Hollywood Hillsin hääpaikkaa ja julkisuudesta tunnettujen vieraiden osallistumista koskevat yksityiskohdat ovat siten yhdysvaltalaismedioiden kertomia.

## Polttareita Malibussa ja Las Vegasissa

Ennen häitä Healy vietti polttareitaan Malibussa. Sosiaalisessa mediassa julkaistuilla videoilla hän esiintyi 9075:n kanssa. Kyseessä on The 1975:n musiikkia esittävä tribuuttiyhtye. Bechtel puolestaan juhli tulevia häitä polttarimatkalla Las Vegasissa häitä edeltäneen kuukauden aikana.

## Suhde tuli julkisuuteen vuonna 2023

Healy ja Bechtel yhdistettiin toisiinsa julkisuudessa ensimmäisen kerran vuonna 2023. Suhde tuli esiin joitakin kuukausia sen jälkeen, kun Healyn lyhyeksi jäänyt suhde laulaja Taylor Swiftin kanssa oli päättynyt. Healy ja Swift seurustelivat tietojen mukaan vain muutaman viikon ajan vuonna 2023. Heidän suhteensa alkoi sen jälkeen, kun Swift oli eronnut Joe Alwynista.

Healy ja Swift yhdistettiin toisiinsa myös vuonna 2014, mutta Healy kuvaili myöhemmin tuolloisia seurusteluhuhuja täysin keksityiksi ja farssiksi. Swiftin myöhemmän The Tortured Poets Department -albumin joidenkin kappaleiden on julkisuudessa arveltu käsittelevän heidän suhdettaan, mutta tästä ei ole esitetty vahvistusta. Bechtelin ja Healyn suhde eteni julkisesta seurustelusta kihlaukseen ja nyt yksityisessä piirissä vietettyihin häihin.
summary_bullets: Matty Healy ja Gabbriette Bechtel avioituivat lauantaina Los Angelesissa.
Yksityiseen seremoniaan osallistui parin perhettä ja läheisiä ystäviä.
Pari aloitti seurustelun syyskuussa 2023 ja kertoi kihlauksestaan vuonna 2024.

Gabbriette Bechtel and Matty Healy married in a private ceremony on Saturday The 1975's frontman Matty Healy and model Gabriette Bechtel have tied the knot in Los Angeles. The couple announced their engagement in 2024, after dating for nine months, and got married on Saturday. A statement shared from the couple's representatives said the pair were married "at a private ceremony in Los Angeles, attended by their family and close friends". According to several US media outlets, they were married at Madonna's former estate in the Hollywood Hills and celebrities including Charli XCX were in attendance. Bechtel, 28 and Healy, 37 were first linked months after he split from Taylor Swift, whom he dated briefly in 2023. Their relationship allegedly inspired some of the tracks on Swift's acclaimed album, The Tortured Poets Department.

The newlyweds were first linked in 2023 after Healy's brief relationship with Taylor Swift.

Before the wedding, Healy celebrated with a bachelor party in Malibu. Videos shared on social media showed him performing with 9075, a tribute band dedicated to The 1975. Bechtel also celebrated with a bachelorette trip to Las Vegas last month. The couple began dating in September 2023. Healy's mother, actress Denise Welch, confirmed their engagement in June 2024. Before his relationship with Bechtel, Healy briefly dated Taylor Swift in 2023 after her split from Joe Alwyn. The two were linked for only a few weeks before going their separate ways. They had also sparked dating rumours in 2014, although Healy later described those rumours as "all fake" and a "farce." Swift has since married Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce.
